description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahengama, Kuruvita D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620274
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral mapping - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category.
